A Prompts in LLM generations A.1 Q-A Rephrasing For stylistic consistency, we expand the answers in the QA data entries into sentences. To do so, we use the Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 model (Jiang et al., 2023), and prompt it to take in a Q-A pair and convert it into a declarative sentence. We use one in-context example in the prompt, and wrap the prompt in a chat template provided with Mistral: User: Paraphrase the following Q-A pair into a proposition
